## our story

At [Let’s Smile Dentistry](https://letssmiledentistry.com/), we believe that a healthy smile is the beginning of a fulfilling life.

Our dental clinic, located in Mexicali, Baja California, Mexico, offers comprehensive[dental care services](https://letssmiledentistry.com/dental-services/)for patients of all ages, from pediatric dentistry to advanced orthodontics, dental implants and fullmouth rehabilitation, all under one roof.

We combine digital diagnostics, cutting-edge technology, and a team of specialized professionals to provide personalized care that is both preventive and compassionate. Our purpose goes beyond treatment,[we exist to transform smiles and lives](https://letssmiledentistry.com/gallery/).

Every patient who walks through our doors becomes part of our story. We’re here to create comfort, trust, and genuine connection through dentistry that feels human, modern, and meaningful.

A healthy smile can change your day, your confidence, and even your life — and we’re honored to be part of that transformation. Because we truly believe that the first step toward happiness is simple: Let’s Smile.

![Image 11: Dr. Tomás García and Andrea Moreno, founders of Let's Smile Dentistry clinic in Mexicali.](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Lets-Smile-Dentistry-Founders-1.webp)

## Founding  
 Let’s Smile Dentistry

After 13 years as a dentist and 10 years as an Oral Implantology Specialist, my wife Andrea and I decided to bring a lifelong dream to life — the creation of Let’s Smile Dentistry.

From the very beginning of my dental studies, I knew that one day I would open my own clinic — a place where patients of all ages could receive the highest quality care under one roof, guided by the best specialists in every area of dentistry.

After years of planning and overcoming countless challenges, that dream became a reality. Today, Let’s Smile Dentistry is proud to have a team of highly qualified professionals who share the same vision and values: to provide exceptional, compassionate, and personalized dental care.

We promise a unique and comfortable experience, powered by cutting-edge technology, a skilled team, and a genuine passion for helping people improve their smiles. Choosing us means more than just taking the first step toward better oral health — it means trusting a team dedicated to making that journey positive, safe, and truly life-changing.

You won’t regret choosing Let’s Smile Dentistry — because your smile deserves nothing less than the best.

[![Image 12: Dr. Tomás García, DDS, experienced oral implantologist and dental implant specialist in Mexicali.](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Tomas-Garcia-Lets-Smile-Dentistry-Founder-1-819x1024.webp)](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Tomas-Garcia-Lets-Smile-Dentistry-Founder-1.webp)

## Meet Dr. Tomás García, DDS

I’ve always considered myself someone who strives for excellence — not only for my own growth, but for every patient I care for.

My greatest satisfaction comes from helping people regain their function, confidence, and the joy of smiling again. I believe the smallest details make the biggest difference, which is why I approach every case with precision, passion, and a commitment to perfection.

Continuous education is one of my deepest professional values. Every new course, technique, or protocol I learn allows me to deliver treatments that are more accurate, efficient, and comfortable for my patients.

My philosophy is simple: dental care should never be something to fear…

[![Image 13: Dr. Ángel Alvarado, DDS, endodontist and root canal specialist at Let's Smile Dentistry Mexicali.](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/DDS-Angel-Alvarado-Root-Canal-Specialist-Mexicali-1-819x1024.webp)](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/DDS-Angel-Alvarado-Root-Canal-Specialist-Mexicali-1.webp)

## Meet Dr. Ángel Alvarado, DDS

Dr. Ángel Alvarado, Specialized Endodontist and Dental Surgeon with a Specialty in Endodontics. My dental practice is focused on preserving teeth and restoring my patients’ oral health by eliminating infections, relieving severe pain, and avoiding unnecessary extractions.

My goal is always to provide high-quality, personalized, and empathetic care tailored to each patient’s needs. I have experience with microscope-assisted treatments, anxious patients, and complex cases of severe dental pain. I prioritize clear and friendly communication so that every patient understands their treatment and feels comfortable and safe throughout the entire process.

I stay up to date through ongoing courses in dental pharmacology, sleep medicine for patients with apnea, and advanced endodontic techniques. Regain your dental health and give your teeth a second chance!

From a young age, I was curious about dentistry—mainly because no one in my family practiced it. While most chose careers in engineering, accounting, or education, I wanted to pursue something different and connected to health. Today, what I enjoy most about my profession is getting to know each patient’s story and helping them regain confidence in their smile and overall well-being.

**My Approach:** I’m known for providing empathetic, respectful, and personalized care. I truly believe in taking the time to explain every diagnosis and treatment so that my patients feel supported and we can make the best decision for their health together

Dra. María José Ochoa is a general dentist passionate about helping people improve and maintain their oral health. Her focus is on general and preventive dentistry, providing personalized care and high-quality treatments.

She is characterized by her warm, kind, and professional approach, always attending to her patients’ needs with empathy and creating an environment of trust, calm, and comfort in every visit. She is committed to offering a human-centered approach and a positive experience for every patient.

Her goal is not only to take care of oral health, but also to help each patient feel safe, heard, and satisfied with their smile and the care they receive.

*   Bachelor’s Degree in Dentistry from UABC (Universidad Autónoma de Baja California)

## Meet Dr. Daniel Aguilar, DDS

I chose to become a dentist because I truly enjoy helping people regain confidence in their smiles. For me, there’s nothing more rewarding than seeing a patient eat comfortably, smile freely, and live happier. Every smile restored is a step toward a more confident and joyful community.

My practice focuses on soft tissue management around implants, microsurgery, full-arch immediate load techniques, and digital dentistry — always with a commitment to precision, comfort, and long-term results.

*   Good to know

*   Dental Surgeon and Periodontics Specialist
*   Master in the Periodontics Specialty at (Universidad Autonoma de Baja California)

*   Fun to know

## Meet Dr. Rodrigo González

Dentistry for me is a fascinating blend of art, science, and technology that allows me to restore function and aesthetics while constantly learning and evolving.

My passion for this field grew as I discovered how digital tools can enhance precision and creativity in every step of dental rehabilitation.

I believe dentistry goes beyond technique — it’s about connecting with people, understanding their needs, and creating personalized treatments that truly improve their quality of life.

## Meet our Co-Founder & Administrator

Hi, I’m Andrea Moreno, co-founder of Let’s Smile Dentistry. Although the dental world was completely new to me at first, being part of this journey has given me a deep appreciation for my husband Tomás’ passion for dentistry and patient care.

With a background in Business Management, I oversee daily operations, support our team, and ensure every patient feels welcomed and valued from the moment they walk through our doors. One of the most rewarding parts of my role is seeing patients leave happy not only because of their smile, but because of the experience they had with us. Creating those moments is something I genuinely love and take pride in every day.

I lead the clinic’s strategy and administration to ensure everything operates with precision. I manage resources and behind-the-scenes operational details, ensuring your experience is organized and professional from start to finish.

With a Bachelor’s Degree in Criminology, my approach is built on detailed analysis and strategic sharpness. My transition into the healthcare field allowed me to discover a passion for administrative management, where my perfectionist nature drives me to optimize every process. This ensures our medical team can focus exclusively on your care. I combine analytical precision with continuous training in healthcare management to ensure our clinic’s structure remains the pillar of an excellent patient experience.

## Meet our Patient Experience Manager

My name is Fer Acosta and I am the Patient Experience Manager at Let’s Smile Dentistry. My role is to make sure every patient feels welcomed, supported, informed, and genuinely cared for throughout their entire dental journey.

With 20+ years of experience in customer service and patient care, I have dedicated my career to helping people feel comfortable and confident during moments that can sometimes feel stressful or overwhelming. I am a certified medical interpreter, bilingual in English and Spanish, with a background in medicine, I bridge the gap between clinical excellence and human connection.

Over the years, I have completed numerous courses and diplomas focused on healthcare, communication, leadership, and patient experience, all of which have helped shape the way I connect with people today.

For me, patients always come first. I believe that trust, compassion, and communication are just as important as the treatment itself. From the very first message to the final appointment, I want every patient to know they are never alone in the process.

“I will be there for my patients every step of the way, because to me, every patient becomes family.”

That philosophy is at the heart of everything I do at Let’s Smile Dentistry.

Scan · plan · coordinate

## Technology that helps your dentist see more, and helps you understand why.

Digital tools are most useful when they make care clearer. Our workflow combines three-dimensional records with specialist judgment to explain options and coordinate treatment.

![Image 17: RAYPreMiere CBCT imaging equipment at Let’s Smile Dentistry](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/lets-smile-dentistry-raypremiere-cbct-5d-planning-mexicali.webp)

3D diagnostics
### CBCT + 5D planning

RAYPreMiere creates three-dimensional records of dental and facial anatomy. Its 5D planning tools help clinicians visualize key structures and explain the plan with greater clarity.

*   Focused scan areas based on clinical need
*   Supports implant, endodontic, and orthodontic assessment
*   Visual records for clearer treatment conversations

![Image 18: Dentist reviewing an intraoral scan with a patient at Let’s Smile Dentistry](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/lets-smile-dentistry-intraoral-scanning-mexicali.webp)

Digital records
### Intraoral scanning

Aoralscan Elite and Medit i700 create digital records of teeth and bite, reducing the need for conventional impressions when clinically appropriate.

*   Detailed records for treatment planning
*   Visual review of scans with your dentist
*   Supports implant and restorative workflows

![Image 19: RAYFace facial scanning workstation at Let’s Smile Dentistry](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/lets-smile-dentistry-rayface-digital-imaging-mexicali.webp)

Virtual patient
### 3D facial scanning

RAYFace brings facial scans, intraoral records, and CBCT data together in a 3D view that supports planning and smile-design conversations.

*   Facial context alongside dental records
*   More visual treatment discussions
*   Connected data across the digital workflow

![Image 20: Ceramill milling equipment used in a CAD CAM dental workflow](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/lets-smile-dentistry-ceramill-cad-cam-milling-mexicali.webp)

Connected workflow
### CAD/CAM laboratory coordination

Digital records move from scanning to design and laboratory fabrication with fewer manual handoffs, supporting coordinated restorative care.

*   Digital design for restorative workflows
*   Clearer review between clinicians and laboratory
*   Timelines based on treatment and fabrication needs

Biosecurity & clinical infrastructure

## Safety built into every clinical workflow.

We invest in certified German and Italian medical infrastructure to guarantee 100% sterile instruments, pure medical-grade air, and active cross-contamination protection you can trust before treatment.

![Image 21: Euronda E10 Class B autoclave used for instrument sterilization](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/euronda-e10-class-b-autoclave-sterilization-lets-smile-dentistry-mexicali.webp)

Euronda · Italy
### E10 Class B sterilization

Deep sterilization with the Pro System workflow and traceable records for instruments prepared for each patient.

*   Class B vacuum sterilization cycles
*   Cleaning, packaging, and protected storage
*   High-level protection against bacteria, viruses and other microorganisms

[View E10 specifications ↗](https://prosystem.euronda.com/product/e10/)

![Image 22: Dürr Dental Tornado compressor for oil-free medical-grade air](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/durr-tornado-oil-free-medical-air-compressor-lets-smile-dentistry-mexicali.webp)

Dürr Dental · Germany
### Medical-grade air

The Tornado compressor supplies dry, hygienic air without oil for the dental units used during care.

*   100% oil-free compressed air
*   Membrane drying technology
*   Clean air for clinical procedures

[See Tornado specifications ↗](https://www.duerrdental.com/en/GB/products/compressed-air/devices/tornado-compressors/)

![Image 23: Dürr Dental Tyscor hygienic suction system with anti-retraction protection](https://letssmiledentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/durr-tyscor-hygienic-anti-retraction-suction-lets-smile-dentistry-mexicali.webp)

Dürr Dental · Germany
### Hygienic anti-retraction suction

Tyscor suction helps prevent negative pressure and the backflow of contaminated fluids through the suction line.

*   Anti-retraction protection
*   Continuous, controlled airflow
*   Designed for patient protection
